conversion_policy: Prices, sizes and timestamps are exact; nothing is rounded. Source publisher and instrument IDs are kept; the channel is the source channel_id, or 0 when the file has none. NWT sequences restart at 1 per (publisher, channel); the source sequence number is not carried. Source flags are not carried. Asset class: stock 1, future 2, call and put 3, every other source class 0 (unspecified). Currency is the row's currency, or --currency where the row has none; the quantity unit is --quantity-unit. Exercise style comes only from a filled option CFI code (third letter A or E); otherwise unknown. quantity_increment and contract_multiplier are null: the source has no equivalent column.
